as_told.title: Scientists sickened by entering the recovered craft
as_told.place_text: Aztec crash site, Hart Canyon, New Mexico

plain: After a craft is said to have crashed in Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, in 1948, the scientists who went inside it supposedly could not stay long without harm. Michels says it himself: "They can't stay inside the craft for longer than 20 minutes at a time because some negative energy overcomes them." A man named Scott Ramsey, who took Michels to the site, tells it at two removes: a man told him that a woman had told him that scientists going into the craft "if they were in there any longer would come out sick." If true, it would mean the craft gave off something dangerous to humans.
